## DESCRIPTION

PLEASE INCLUDE A SUMMARY OF THE CHANGE AND WHICH ISSUE IS FIXED.

## TYPE_OF_CHANGE

PLEASE DELETE OPTIONS THAT ARE NOT RELEVANT.

- [ ] BUG FIX (NON-BREAKING CHANGE WHICH FIXES AN ISSUE)
- [ ] NEW FEATURE (NON-BREAKING CHANGE WHICH ADDS FUNCTIONALITY)
- [ ] BREAKING CHANGE (FIX OR FEATURE THAT WOULD CAUSE EXISTING FUNCTIONALITY TO NOT WORK AS EXPECTED)
- [ ] DOCUMENTATION UPDATE
- [ ] REFACTORING (NO FUNCTIONAL CHANGES)
- [ ] BUILD/CI IMPROVEMENT

## HOW_HAS_THIS_BEEN_TESTED

PLEASE DESCRIBE THE TESTS THAT YOU RAN TO VERIFY YOUR CHANGES. PROVIDE INSTRUCTIONS SO THAT WE CAN REPRODUCE.

- [ ] `npm test` PASSES
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` PASSES
- [ ] `npm run lint` PASSES
- [ ] `npm run build` PASSES

## CHECKLIST

- [ ] MY CODE FOLLOWS THE STYLE GUIDELINES OF THIS PROJECT
- [ ] I HAVE PERFORMED A SELF-REVIEW OF MY OWN CODE
- [ ] I HAVE ADDED TESTS THAT COVER MY CHANGES (IF APPLICABLE)
- [ ] NEW AND EXISTING UNIT TESTS PASS LOCALLY WITH MY CHANGES
- [ ] I HAVE ADDED A CHANGESET FILE UNDER `.changeset/` (IF APPLICABLE)

## SCREENSHOTS

IF APPLICABLE, ADD SCREENSHOTS TO HELP EXPLAIN YOUR CHANGE.
